cards.card_text: On the seventh day, when the king's heart is merry with wine, he calls in the seven eunuchs who serve him: Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar and Carkas.
cards.verse_text: On the seventh day, when the king’s heart was merry with wine, he ordered the seven eunuchs who served him—Mehuman, Biztha, Harbona, Bigtha, Abagtha, Zethar, and Carkas—

cards.card_text: So the eunuchs carry the king's command to Queen Vashti, and the king waits.
cards.verse_text: Queen Vashti, however, refused to come at the king’s command brought by his eunuchs.
cards.snippet: …Vashti, however, refused to come at the king’s command brought by his eunuchs.

cards.card_text: Queen Vashti gets the king's command from his eunuchs.

cards.card_text: There they'll be under the care of Hegai, the king's eunuch in charge of the women, and get beauty treatments.
cards.verse_text: Let them be placed under the care of Hegai, the king’s eunuch in charge of the women, and let them be given beauty treatments.
cards.snippet: Let them be placed under the care of Hegai, the king’s eunuch in charge of the women, and let them be given beauty treatments.

cards.card_text: In the morning she goes to a second harem, under Shaashgaz, the king's eunuch in charge of the concubines.
cards.verse_text: She would go there in the evening, and in the morning she would return to a second harem under the care of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch in charge of the concubines.
cards.snippet: …return to a second harem under the care of Shaashgaz, the king’s eunuch in charge of the concubines.

cards.card_text: Meanwhile, with Mordecai sitting at the gate, two of the king's eunuchs who guard the entrance, Bigthan and Teresh, get angry.
cards.verse_text: In those days, while Mordecai was sitting at the king’s gate, Bigthan and Teresh, two of the king’s eunuchs who guarded the entrance, grew angry and conspired to assassinate King Xerxes.
cards.snippet: …sitting at the king’s gate, Bigthan and Teresh, two of the king’s eunuchs who guarded the entrance, grew angry and conspired to assassinate King Xerxes.

cards.card_text: Over in the palace, Esther's maidens and eunuchs come and tell her about Mordecai.
cards.verse_text: When Esther’s maidens and eunuchs came and told her about Mordecai, the queen was overcome with distress.
cards.snippet: When Esther’s maidens and eunuchs came and told her about Mordecai, the queen was overcome with distress.

cards.card_text: Then Esther summons Hathach, one of the king's eunuchs appointed to her.
cards.verse_text: When Esther’s maidens and eunuchs came and told her about Mordecai, the queen was overcome with distress.

cards.card_text: While they're still talking with Haman, the king's eunuchs arrive.
cards.verse_text: While they were still speaking with Haman, the king’s eunuchs arrived and rushed him to the banquet that Esther had prepared.

cards.card_text: With Haman's face covered, Harbonah, one of the eunuchs attending the king, speaks up.
cards.verse_text: Then Harbonah, one of the eunuchs attending the king, said: “There is a gallows fifty cubits high at Haman’s house.

cards.card_text: The LORD says some of Hezekiah's ___ will be taken away to be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.
cards.verse_text: And some of your descendants, your own flesh and blood, will be taken away to be eunuchs in the palace of the king of Babylon.”

cards.card_text: Next, the eunuch shouldn't say, 'I am but a dry tree.' I think that one hurts.
cards.verse_text: Let no foreigner who has joined himself to the LORD say, “The LORD will utterly exclude me from His people.” And let the eunuch not say, “I am but a dry tree.”
cards.snippet: …“The LORD will utterly exclude me from His people.” And let the eunuch not say, “I am but a dry tree.”

cards.card_text: Then the LORD speaks to the eunuchs who keep His Sabbaths, choose what pleases Him and hold fast to His covenant.
cards.verse_text: For this is what the LORD says: “To the eunuchs who keep My Sabbaths, who choose what pleases Me and hold fast to My covenant—
